function.name: solve_discrete_math
function.description: Calculates math/logic using a highly optimized sandboxed Pascal program. Returns math formulas formatted in LaTeX notation ($...$ or $$...$$). Use this for any precise math, discrete math, complex calculations, or logical equations.

code.description: A self-contained Pascal program. Standard syntax. Must print the final result using WriteLn, formatted in LaTeX. You MUST include the appropriate standard Pascal libraries in your `uses` clause (e.g. Math, SysUtils, Classes, StrUtils) depending on the functions you use. If you encounter a Compilation Error, analyze it. If you lack the knowledge to fix it, use `search_knowledge_base` or `search_web` to find the correct standard library for the missing identifier, then retry execution. If you successfully resolve an error, you MUST call `save_to_knowledge_base` to store the solution for future reference. Example: program MathSol; uses Math, SysUtils; begin WriteLn('$$x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{d}}{2a}$$'); end.
